description: This file defines an API client for interacting with TheMealDB API, including configuration, request handling with retries and error normalization, and methods for searching recipes, fetching details, and generating meal plans.

methods.name: getAuthStatus
methods.description: Returns diagnostics about API configuration, including base URL, proxy, online status, and last failed/proxied URLs (dev only).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a URL with query parameters, applying CORS proxy if configured, and avoiding double prefixing.

methods.name: toFriendlyNetworkMessage
methods.description: Converts network errors into user-friendly messages, handling timeouts, offline status, and fetch failures.

methods.name: normalizeError
methods.description: Normalizes HTTP response errors from TheMealDB, interpreting empty results and error messages.

methods.name: requestJson
methods.description: Performs fetch with timeout, retries on transient errors, and returns JSON or text data.

methods.name: mapMealToRecipe
methods.description: Maps a meal object from TheMealDB to the application's internal recipe format.

methods.name: extractIngredients
methods.description: Extracts ingredient and measure pairs from a meal object.

methods.name: searchRecipes
methods.description: Searches for recipes by name, returning mapped results.

methods.name: getRecipeDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed recipe information by ID.

methods.name: getNutrition
methods.description: Returns placeholder nutrition info as TheMealDB does not provide nutrition data.

methods.name: getRandomRecipe
methods.description: Fetches a random meal and maps it to the recipe format.

methods.name: listByCategory
methods.description: Lists recipes filtered by category with minimal fields.

methods.name: listByArea
methods.description: Lists recipes filtered by area with minimal fields.

methods.name: generateMealPlan
methods.description: Generates a simple meal plan with one random recipe.

methods.name: getMealPlanNutrition
methods.description: Returns placeholder nutrition info for a meal plan.

methods.name: getGroceryList
methods.description: Generates a grocery list from a meal plan's ingredients.

methods.name: healthCheck
methods.description: Performs a lightweight check to verify connectivity and API responsiveness.
